parts.name: main rotor
parts.massBasis: Main rotor assembly (hub, swashplate linkages, 2-3 composite/metal blades) for ~1800 kg class helicopter. Blades are thin elongated airfoils radiating from a compact hub; planar variance well below uniform disk (~0.125 for a ring) because hub mass pulls distribution inward. Z-extent small; hub dominates, giving low z-variance. ~90-100 kg typical for this class.

parts.name: crew door
parts.massBasis: Light-helicopter crew door: aluminium honeycomb skin over frame, ~2 mm equivalent shell with hinges and latch hardware. Mass concentrated in skin panels; z-extent includes frame depth, so variance in z is lower than a solid block. Slight x-bias toward hinge side.

parts.name: tail rotor
parts.massBasis: Tail rotor: small 2-blade assembly with hub and pitch-change mechanism, ~1.2 m diameter. Blades are thin; hub and gearbox housing concentrate mass near center. Z very thin (blade chord + hub). Typical 12-16 kg for light helicopter tail rotor.

parts.massBasis: Small rectangular service access panel, thin aluminium sheet with quick-release fasteners. Nearly uniform thin-shell panel; y is the thin axis so variance slightly reduced. Mass ≈ 5-6 kg typical for light-helicopter cowling panel.
